visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow sleeveless top and silver earrings, looks into the camera and then upwards against a night city background. The scene cuts to a massive ancient stone amphitheater under a bright blue sky, followed by a shot of another ruined stone structure with tall columns during the golden hour. (2) The camera moves through various locations in Rome; a bus drives past historical buildings under a sunny sky. The interior of a grand building with highly ornate, gilded ceilings and large murals is shown. A woman in a white dress and a man with a microphone stand near an information board featuring a famous religious mural. (3) The scene shifts back to the large stone amphitheater, showing its tiered interior structure and the excavated central arena. Tourists are visible walking along the various levels under the clear sun. (4) Footage displays an expansive archaeological site with stone archways, foundations, and standing columns. A wide panoramic view from a high vantage point reveals more ruins interspersed with greenery and modern city buildings in the distance. (5) The setting changes to a large, illuminated ornate fountain at night with numerous statues and flowing water. A large crowd of people is gathered in front of it, some holding up phones. (6) A final montage shows a large golden sphere sculpture in a courtyard, a person holding a camera, and a wide view of a city skyline from a balcony with a black railing under a hazy sky.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 挑戰不可能任務. [Logo]: @lovemiihuang. [Slogan]: Mission: Impossible Challenge. (2) [Subtitle]: 一天逛完羅馬四大景點. [Slogan]: Visiting Rome's Four Major Landmarks in One Day. (3) [Subtitle]: 嗨我是小米. [Slogan]: Hi, I'm MiI!. (4) [Subtitle]: 這是我們在義大利的最後一天. [Slogan]: This is our last day in Italy. (5) [Subtitle]: 第一站梵蒂岡. [Slogan]: First stop: The Vatican. (6) [Subtitle]: 不愧是禧年，人潮真的非常多. [Slogan]: No surprise—it's the Jubilee Year, and the crowds are insane!. (7) [Subtitle]: 想要好好了解歷史與文化，推薦可以買導覽套票. [Slogan]: If you really want to understand the history and culture, I recommend getting a guided tour ticket. (8) [Subtitle]: 很多作品都是因為有解說，才更印象深刻. [Slogan]: Many artworks become even more impressive once you know their stories!. (9) [Subtitle]: (裡面不能拍照也不能錄影) 千萬別錯過西斯汀大教堂. [Slogan]: Don't miss the Sistine Chapel. (10) [Subtitle]: 「最後的審判」真的太震撼了. [Slogan]: The Last Judgment is absolutely breathtaking. (11) [Subtitle]: 第二站羅馬競技場. [Slogan]: Second stop: The Colosseum. (12) [Subtitle]: 站在場中央平台親身體驗近2000年的古蹟. [Slogan]: Standing on the central platform, you can feel the weight of 2,000 years of history. (13) [Subtitle]: 不得不讚嘆以前的工程技術與美感. [Slogan]: You can't help but admire the ancient engineering and aesthetics. (14) [Subtitle]: 票種非常多，有機會一定要買 Arena 跟地下層的套票. [Slogan]: If you can, get the Arena + Underground access combo!. (15) [Subtitle]: 第三站古羅馬廣場. [Slogan]: Third stop: The Roman Forum. (16) [Subtitle]: 就在競技場旁邊，是以前的城市中心. [Slogan]: Right next to the Colosseum, it used to be the heart of the city. (17) [Subtitle]: 記得一定要走上帕拉提諾山丘，拍起來視野超級好. [Slogan]: Be sure to walk up Palatine Hill—the view is incredible!. (18) [Subtitle]: 最後一站特雷維噴泉. [Slogan]: Final stop: Trevi Fountain. (19) [Subtitle]: 晚上10點還是一大堆人. [Slogan]: It's still packed even at 10 p.m.!. (20) [Subtitle]: 夜晚的許願池也滿有氛圍感的. [Slogan]: But the night view of the wishing fountain has its own charm. (21) [Subtitle]: 一天走完真的很累，但也很值得. [Slogan]: We were totally exhausted by the end of the day, but it was so worth it. (22) [Subtitle]: 下次回訪義大利，一定要再把羅馬玩個透徹. [Slogan]: Next time we come back to Italy, we're definitely exploring Rome in full!
